answer: The nectar cap is policed at intake and island reveals the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a whisper tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 2 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
